questions.key: Specialists depend on a narrow food source and a stable habitat -- the panda on bamboo, the koala on eucalyptus. Pythons are generalists: they tolerate a wide range of habitats, temperatures and foods, and do best in and around humans. One mark for the specialist constraint, one for both examples drawn from the article, one for the generalist contrast.
